item.name: Customer Form Template - Create or Update

header.description: Required. Without it P21 answers with XML (HTTP 200) on current builds, and an empty HTTP 500 on 2026.1 builds up to 5910.3.

request.description: PUT is the only write verb -- no POST exists. NOT a blind upsert: null CustomerFormTemplateUid means create, and create fails 'data already exists' if the customer already has a row. The first run against a fresh customer returns 200 and creates it; running this exact request AGAIN reproduces the trap on purpose -- a 500 'data already exists' is the expected, documented behavior on a second run, not a broken request. To update instead, set CustomerFormTemplateUid to the real value from customer_form_template over OData.
